title: Mistik's Kill Effects
description: This project adds the ORIGINAL Mistik SMP plugin to any server you desire. It works by getting PLAYER KILLS. the kill counter resets upon death.
body:
**The ORIGINAL Mistik SMP kill effect plugin**
MistikSMP Strength-Style Kill Effects

MistikSMP Strength-Style Kill Effects is a lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin inspired by Strength SMP–style PvP progression. Players earn permanent potion effects as they get player kills, creating fast-paced combat where streaks matter and death has real consequences.

As players rack up kills, they unlock stronger effects that persist indefinitely until death or until they are upgraded. When a player dies, all effects granted by the plugin are removed and their kill count resets to zero. There are no commands, permissions, or configuration required; the plugin works automatically once installed.

Kill rewards:

- 1 kill: Strength I

- 2 kills: Speed I

- 5 kills: Fire Resistance

- 10 kills: Absorption II

- 12 kills: Strength II (replaces Strength I)

- 15 kills: Speed II (replaces Speed I)

more kill rewards coming soon

All effects are permanent until death. The kill-count resets upon death.

Features:

1. Strength SMP–style PvP progression

2. Automatic effect upgrades

3. Full reset of kills and effects on death

4. Lightweight and efficient

5. No commands or configuration needed

Compatibility:

Minecraft 1.20+

Spigot and Paper

No dependencies

This plugin is ideal for PvP-focused SMPs, event servers, or any server looking to add risk–reward combat progression without unnecessary complexity.
